backend: Identical recovery, catalogue reconfirmation and conditional workflow policies in A and B; fixed default theme and synthetic fixtures.

journeys.simple: Reach dish with keyboard, open named dialog, add once, select table and submit; one accepted order at 8.
journeys.options: Reach and select Large and Bread by keyboard; selected state exposed; add and submit one order at 12.
journeys.cart: Add dish, increase then decrease quantity using named buttons; total returns to 8 before submission.
journeys.invalid-table: Submit without table; visible/announced instruction, no accepted order; select table and successfully retry.
journeys.unavailable: Item becomes unavailable after cart creation; actionable error, no accepted order, no trapped pending purchase.
journeys.status: Place order; preparing and ready updates are exposed as status messages, bill request is announced; reload retains accepted order.

manualOrder: Record AI-assisted keyboard/focus/bounds observations before reading axe reports for that version. Pointer fallback is recorded as a blocked keyboard step, never a keyboard pass.
core: Six journeys at 390 and 1280 CSS pixels in Chromium for A and B: 24 runs.
reflow: Menu, customisation, cart and status at 320 CSS pixels in A and B: eight checks. This is viewport reflow, not browser zoom.
firefox: Options, invalid-table and status at 1280 CSS pixels for A and B: six runs, subject to pilot availability.
screenReader: Actual NVDA on Chromium: customisation, validation and status in both versions. Pending separate desktop availability/permission; ARIA snapshots are not NVDA evidence.
limits: Automated rules, keyboard traces and screenshots cannot establish full WCAG conformance or substitute for user testing. Record unresolved/manual-only results separately.
